title: Terminal 3 Build+Scale Agent Micro Grant
description:
# We are looking for trusted agents that actually solve a problem with early but real signs of adoption.

## With [T3 Developer Platform](https://terminal3.io/products/agent-developer-kit), you can now allow AI to work with the most sensitive and private information, without exposing it.

Unleash the full potential of AI agents today. No more prototypes, let's start getting real users to use agents for themselves and their businesses.

## **What do builders get?**

- Top 2 builders with their agentic solutions will get access to our **cash micro-grant pool of US$1,800**
- **All T3 credits consumed** during this period will be fully covered by Terminal 3. Don't worry if you're scaling post-challenge as well because we will scale up credits will be available for projects in this challenge.
- Post-grant top teams will also be referred to our partner Google Cloud to qualify for over **$100,000 GCP credits** as entires into their startup program
- Terminal 3 will include your build in our curated Agent Directory + plug you into exclusive events co-hosted with institutions and enterprises across the markets we are in
- During this period, you will get dedicated support from the T3 team for technical or co-marketing support to help with user adoption

## What are the grant criteria / milestones?

- **Traction (80%)** - the solution with the highest user adoption during this period scores the highest.
    - Gauged by : the credits consumed (provided by us) across your set of unique DIDs and your submitted user dashboard / analytics or any other proof.
- **Visibility (20%) -** no one will use your solution if noone sees it, the submission with the highest hype and visibility online scores the highest.
    - Gauged by : following our [X](https://x.com/terminal3io) and participating in our [Developer TG group](https://t.me/terminal3developer) and social media content impressions, engagement for your solution. (remember to tag @terminal3io so that we can help you amplify!)

## Can I build it with AI?

Yes. But please refrain from simply submitting AI generated code actual execution for user adoption.

## Can it be an existing build?

Yes. Your success will rely on how well you can integrate Terminal 3 Developer Platform SDK so that the existing user base can get you up to speed.

## Who should participate?

This grant program is for people who are looking to build real products and ideally to scale it into a company. We are here to help anyone through our industry network to get their foot through the door.

## Who should not participate?

Bounty hunters and anyone who just spams projects by using AI to build hopefully to get some prizes. This is not for you.

But if you prefer to move away from constantly having to rebuild shell products and want to start scaling something meaningful, we'd love to give you a headstart here!

## Any questions or need more credit? Join our ***[Developer TG group @terminal3developer](https://t.me/terminal3developer)***

submission_form.question: List all the DIDs involved in your build so we can accurately collate the credits and action logs for the Traction milestone.
Give me a one-liner about your solution
Why does your solution need agentic governance and security? How are you using T3 for this?

tracks.name: T3N integrated agent with the most traction
tracks.description:
We are looking for agentic solutions that solve real pain points and serve actual users. The submission with the highest traction wins.

No limits on industry, use cases (except for anything illegal or unethical) or platforms.
